title: 第8章 怎么睡
slug: 班级地铁求生全班就我一个男生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

家人们谁懂啊。

一群美女穿着比基尼，当着你的面嬉戏打闹。

莺莺燕燕。

一波未平，一波又起。

一般的干部经不起这样的考验啊！

秦守靠在自动售货机后面，把身体往冰凉的金属外壳上贴了贴。

冷静！冷静！

对面，女生们还在闹。

陆小小张开双臂满车厢追，某些饱满随着奔跑上下剧烈颠簸，比基尼布料绷得死紧，随时可能撑爆。

她浑然不觉，眼睛只盯着林雪儿。

“雪儿，你就让我亲一下嘛！”

林雪儿俏脸嫣红。

“不、不要！”

陆小小又扑过去，林雪儿侧身再躲。

二女追逐打闹。

陆小小虽然性格活泼，但她的惯性太大——怎么也追不上林雪儿。

陆小小眼珠一转。

“啊，木哥，小心啊！”

她突然惊叫一声，目光越过林雪儿的肩头，惊恐地看向车门方向。

林雪儿脸色大变，本能地转头看去。

她看到车门关得好好的，什么都没有。

秦守靠在售货机后面，正一脸无辜地回望过来，也不知道发生了什么。

上当了！

林雪儿心中暗道不妙，可惜已经晚了。

陆小小趁机一个飞扑，直接把林雪儿扑倒在座椅垫上。

两个人摔在一起。

陆小小趴在林雪儿身上。

比基尼互相挤压出令人脸红的弧度。

林雪儿微微喘着气，白皙的脸颊上泛起一层薄薄的绯红。

“放，放开我……”

陆小小得意地舔了舔嘴角。

“抓到你了，雪儿。快让我亲一口！”

陆小小来真的，低头就亲下去。

林雪儿偏头躲开。

陆小小的嘴唇擦着林雪儿的耳垂滑过。

林雪儿轻轻“嗯”了一声，耳根以肉眼可见的速度红透了。

秦守看得一愣一愣的。

这真是不付费就能解锁的内容吗？

“好了。”

姜瑶的声音响起。

美女班长走了过来，脊背挺直，目光扫过座椅垫上缠成一团的两个美女。

她的表情是班会课上维持纪律时的平静，但她的耳尖微微泛着一层淡粉。

“别闹了，升级天赋的特殊条件，不可能是亲吻。”

姜瑶在一众女生中威信极高，她开口发话了，陆小小不再胡闹，放开了林雪儿。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Who in the family understands?

A group of beauties are wearing bikinis and playing in front of you.

Ying Ying Yan Yan.

One wave has not subsided, and another wave has arisen.

Ordinary cadres cannot withstand such a test!

Qin Shou leaned behind the vending machine and pressed his body against the cold metal shell.

calm!calm!

Across the way, the girls were still making trouble.

Lu Xiaoxiao opened his arms and chased her all over the car. Her body was bumping violently as she ran, and the fabric of her bikini was so tight that it might burst at any time.

She was completely unaware, her eyes only staring at Lin Xueer.

"Xue'er, just let me kiss you!"

Lin Xueer's pretty face turned red.

"No, don't!"

Lu Xiaoxiao rushed over again, and Lin Xueer turned sideways to hide again.

The two girls chased each other and fought.

Although Lu Xiaoxiao has a lively personality, she has too much inertia - she can never catch up with Lin Xueer.

Lu Xiaoxiao rolled his eyes.

"Ah, Brother Mu, be careful!"

She suddenly screamed, looking over Lin Xueer's shoulder and looking towards the car door in horror.

Lin Xueer's expression changed drastically and she instinctively turned her head to look.

She saw that the car door was closed properly and there was nothing there.

Qin Shou was leaning behind the vending machine, looking back with an innocent face, not knowing what was going on.

Fooled!

Lin Xueer secretly thought something was wrong, but unfortunately it was too late.

Lu Xiaoxiao took the opportunity to pounce and threw Lin Xueer directly onto the seat cushion.

The two fell together.

Lu Xiaoxiao lay on Lin Xueer.

The bikinis squeeze each other into a blushing arc.

Lin Xueer panted slightly, and a thin layer of blush appeared on her fair cheeks.

"Let, let me go..."

Lu Xiaoxiao licked the corner of his mouth proudly.

"I caught you, Xueer. Let me kiss you!"

Lu Xiaoxiao was serious, lowered his head and kissed her.

Lin Xueer turned her head to avoid.

Lu's small lips brushed against Lin Xueer's earlobe.

Lin Xueer softly said "Hmm", and her ears turned red at a speed that was visible to the naked eye.

Qin Shou was stunned for a while.

Is this really content that can be unlocked without paying?

"Okay."

Jiang Yao's voice sounded.

The beautiful class monitor walked over, her back straight, and her eyes glanced at the two beauties entangled in a ball on the seat cushion.

Her expression was as calm as maintaining discipline in a class meeting, but the tips of her ears were slightly pink.

"Stop making trouble. The special condition for upgrading your talent cannot be kissing."

Jiang Yao had a high prestige among the girls. When she spoke, Lu Xiaoxiao stopped messing around and let Lin Xueer go.
